Hello! I really love your artwork. It would be an honour to work with you.

I would like the size of the art to be a 16:9 size. Please draw the art in landscape/horizonal format.

This artwork is for my song cover of Vampire by DECO*27. Please draw my character in the same style and casual outfit as the art of the song! https://imgur.com/a/IW4y8Uy
Thank you so much for your time.

(Please keep in mind the birthmark on my character's breasts and her face!)
